title: Middling Quality and Function
text: Middling Quality and Function. It works. It never feels like you got it as clean as you would have if you swept the floor which is the opposite of what I feel when I use a vac. I don't know if it's the design or if I just don't like manual roller sweepers but I just felt it did an OK job. That being said, it's not super expensive and was very easy to use, low impact, and mostly silent. It would be good for someone with mobility issues that needed to clean up a little bit. While it's mostly silent, mine got bent or off track somehow and started making a whining noise about a month after purchase. Also, the handle is a bit bent now from regular use. If you can get it for under $24, I think its worth it.

description: A cleaning classic, the BISSELL Natural Sweep Dual Brush Sweeper's simple, yet effective, cleaning method dates back over 140 years to Melville and Anna Bissell's introduction of one of the first carpet sweepers. Now perfected for today's cleaning needs, the BISSELL Natural Sweep is great for quick, quiet cleanups on carpets, area rugs, and hard floors in between regular vacuuming. Its Dual Rotating Brushes work on both forward and return passes to pick up large debris such as cereal, beads, and crumbs plus fine particles such as dirt, dust, and pet hair. In addition, the Natural Sweep has small brushes placed on 2 corners of its foot to capture dirt and debris along edges and in corners. Its compact, durable, yet lightweight, design is environmentally preferred, containing no PVC, and contains parts made of 100% recycled plastic. It also requires no electricity to operate and no wasteful disposable products. BISSELL Natural Sweep comes with a lifetime . Buying this product saves pets.
